match_key.description: Identifies the same invoice record across both files

comparison_rules.description: Compare amounts numerically within tolerance of 0.01

source_relationship.description: Both supplier-statement.txt and ledger-book.txt are independent peer sources. Report missing records from either side and differences in Amount field.

discrepancies_to_report: Invoice numbers present in one file but not the other
Amount differences exceeding tolerance when InvoiceNumber matches
notes: This definition captures the business agreement: match on InvoiceNumber, compare Amount within 0.01 tolerance, Currency is ignored (all samples are GBP), both files have equal authority as peer sources.
